programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    color = next(c for row in grid for c in row if c != grid[0][0])\n    best = None\n    for r1 in range(h):\n        for r2 in range(r1 + 2, h):\n            for c1 in range(w):\n                for c2 in range(c1 + 2, w):\n                    if (all(grid[r1][c] == color and grid[r2][c] == color for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)) and\n                        all(grid[r][c1] == color and grid[r][c2] == color for r in range(r1, r2 + 1))):\n                        area = (r2 - r1 - 1) * (c2 - c1 - 1)\n                        if best is None or area > best[0]:\n                            best = (area, r1, r2, c1, c2)\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    if best:\n        _, r1, r2, c1, c2 = best\n        for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):\n            for c in range(c1 + 1, c2):\n                out[r][c] = 4\n    return out\n'''
